description: Source code for the DocumentRenderer class in the MigraDoc.Rendering namespace, responsible for rendering documents and parts of documents to graphics objects, managing rendering progress, headers, footers, outlines, and list numbering within the MigraDoc PDF generation library.

classes.name: DocumentRenderer
classes.description: Class providing methods to render a MigraDoc document to graphics, handle headers, footers, outlines, progress events, and manage rendering state.

classes.name: PredefinedFontsAndChars
classes.description: Nested class caching predefined fonts and characters used in rendering, including error fonts and bullets.

classes.name: PredefinedFontsAndChars.PredefinedBullets
classes.description: Nested class within PredefinedFontsAndChars managing bullet fonts and characters for list levels.

classes.name: PrepareDocumentProgressEventArgs
classes.description: Event arguments class for reporting progress during document preparation.

methods.name: PrepareDocument
methods.description: Prepares the document for rendering, including flattening and formatting.

methods.name: OnPrepareDocumentProgress
methods.description: Raises progress event during document preparation.

methods.name: RenderPage
methods.description: Renders a specific page of the document to a graphics object.

methods.name: GetDocumentObjectsFromPage
methods.description: Retrieves document objects rendered on a specific page.

methods.name: GetRenderInfoFromPage
methods.description: Retrieves render info for objects on a specific page.

methods.name: RenderObject
methods.description: Renders a single document object at a specified position.

methods.name: RenderHeader
methods.description: Renders the header for a page.

methods.name: RenderFooter
methods.description: Renders the footer for a page.

methods.name: AddOutline
methods.description: Adds an outline (bookmark) to the PDF document.

methods.name: NextListNumber
methods.description: Calculates the next list number for ordered lists.
